title: claim_check.v1
description: A reference to an object in the object store, carried by an event instead of the object itself (ARCH-024). Every event contract on the factory backbone uses this one definition. A consumer fetches the object and compares its SHA-256 with sha256 before using it; a missing or mismatched object is refused and dead-lettered.

object_version.description: The store's version ID for the object, when the store versions objects.
